scenes.title: Ice slip
scenes.caption: After the title card, Koro the llama skids across a frozen pond trying to reach a patch of red berries.

scenes.title: Train incoming
scenes.caption: A penguin pops up next to the sprawled llama on a railway line while a steam train barrels toward them.

scenes.title: Standoff on the tracks
scenes.caption: The llama panics on the tracks as the train closes in, while the penguin stays completely unbothered.

scenes.title: Berry victory
scenes.caption: The llama snags a berry on its tongue and gloats, the train smashes through, and the pair end up deep in a dark mine.

scenes.title: Mine-cart ride
scenes.caption: A runaway mine-cart ride through the tunnel, with the penguin riding a cart full of berries.

scenes.title: Berries go flying
scenes.caption: The cart bursts out of the mountainside, berries scatter through the air and the llama leaps after them.

scenes.title: Mid-air collision
scenes.caption: Llama and penguin meet face to face in mid-air; the llama's horrified double take.

scenes.title: Crash landing
scenes.caption: The llama tumbles past snowy peaks and lands flat in the snow as the penguin glides by.

scenes.title: Llamigos
scenes.caption: At sunset the lonely llama is met by a whole penguin colony carrying berries, a truce, then the credits.
